name: syncboard-realtime
description: Real-time collaborative Kanban board: React, TypeScript, Socket.IO, Node.js and PostgreSQL with optimistic UI, optimistic concurrency control and reconnection recovery.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @syncboard/server" "npm run dev -w @syncboard/client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client && tsc -p tests
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.build: npm run build -w @syncboard/server && npm run build -w @syncboard/client
